subject: Next steps: stakeholder scan & MAP draft for MedLink
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Erica Chen <erica@medlink.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-11T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: stakeholder scan & MAP draft for MedLink

Hi Erica — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps while items are fresh: 

Call recap:
- Use case: low-latency inference for patient-note summarization and embeddings for search.
- Scale target: 50 concurrent agents in pilot; multiregion (US primary).
- Primary constraints: latency SLOs (~ <150ms p50 on 1k token responses), security/compliance (SOC2 + data residency discussion), procurement timeline aiming for Q3.

Stakeholder scan (from the call, pls confirm):
- Economic buyer: Tom Alvarez (VP Engineering) — please confirm.
- Security reviewer: legal@medlink.ai (you mentioned in passing) — who is the specific security contact?
- Procurement: procurement@medlink.ai (procurement lead name?)
- Solutions champion: Erica Chen (you) — maps to product/engineering sponsor

I've attached an initial MAP (MAP-draft-medlink-v1.pdf) with suggested milestones. High-level asks:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer + procurement payment terms window?
2) Who should we send the security questionnaire to (contact and preferred format)?
3) Agree on a kickoff for a short technical review with our SE (we can do Jun 17 or Jun 18 afternoon PT).

Planned next steps from our side if you confirm above:
- Finalize MAP and milestone dates, include SOC2 evidence and SSO/KMS requirements.
- Provide preliminary pricing estimate for a 90-day pilot and expected committed capacity.
- Schedule kickoff and technical dive with SE.

Attachments: MAP-draft-medlink-v1.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold on sending the MAP v2 until I have Tom/procurement/security contacts.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Erica Chen <erica@medlink.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medlink.ai, legal@medlink.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder scan & MAP draft for MedLink

Thanks Grace — good summary. Confirmations below:

- Economic buyer: Tom Alvarez, VP Engineering (tom.alvarez@medlink.ai). He will be part of final approvals.
- Procurement lead: procurement@medlink.ai is monitored by Priya Patel (procurement@medlink.ai). Targeting PO issuance by 2027-08-15 (internal target).
- Legal point: legal@medlink.ai (contracts@medlink.ai forwarded to Sarah Lim, Sr. Counsel).
- Security reviewer: sending to sec-eng@medlink.ai — primary reviewer is Rajesh Kumar (rajesh.kumar@medlink.ai).

Decision criteria (rough weights from leadership):
- Price / unit economics: 40%
- Latency and stability: 30%
- Data handling / compliance (SOC2, encryption at rest/in transit): 20%
- SLA and support: 10%

Links and notes:
- They prefer questionnaires as a .xlsx — please send vendor security questionnaire and any SOC2 summary.
- Here's an internal procurement portal note that sometimes slows PO approvals: https://procurement.medlink.ai/vendor-onboarding (FYI).

I reviewed your MAP-draft and the milestones look reasonable. Confirm Jun 17 10:00 AM PT for a technical kickoff with your SE and our security lead (Rajesh) — I’ll send an invite once I have the MAP v2.

Erica Chen
Product Lead, MedLink Health
erica@medlink.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: stakeholder scan & MAP draft for MedLink

Folks — forwarding Erica's confirmations. Action items for us before the Jun 17 kickoff: 

1) Pricing: please produce a 90-day pilot estimate and a committed 12-month reserved capacity option (ballpark numbers are fine for now). Attach redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx.
2) Security packet: assemble SOC2 summary and the vendor questionnaire (spreadsheet) they can fill; include SSO (SAML/OIDC) and KMS integration notes.
3) MAP v2: incorporate dates below and call out owner for each milestone (we'll be accountable for pilot infra + SE support). Proposed milestone dates from call:
   - Security review completion: 2027-07-01
   - Pilot contract / PO: 2027-08-15
   - Pilot go-live: 2027-09-01

Also note procurement prefers 30–60 day payment terms. Dylan — can you flag any risky contractual items we should pre-empt? Neha — I’ll need a short one-pager on SSO/KMS requirements for Rajesh.

Thanks — I’ll prepare MAP v2 once I have your inputs.

Grace
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Next steps: stakeholder scan & MAP draft for MedLink

Grace / Neha — quick notes from my side: 

- Pricing (high level): 90-day pilot (burst capacity + streaming) ~ $45k–60k depending on avg token volume (we'll refine). 12-month reserved (committed) option can reduce unit cost by ~35% at ~ $18k/month committed for their baseline. Will attach spreadsheet in follow-up.
- Contract / finance: MedLink usually pushes 60-day net on first-year deals; expect some negotiation on termination liability and data-handling clauses. Legal may ask for a limited indemnity cap — anticipate ~0.5–1.0x ARR cap discussions.
- Security / deployment: SAML SSO and customer-managed KMS (via our KMS connector) supported. Need to confirm Key Custody preference (HSM vs cloud KMS). Neha — can you confirm the exact KMS providers we support and quick config steps?
- SE support: recommend looping Marissa Cole for pilot runbook and perf tuning (marissa_cole@redwood.ai).

Milestone tweaks:
- Security review completion: 2027-07-08 (allow 1 extra week for questionnaire turn-around)
- PO by: 2027-08-15 (agree)
- Pilot go-live: 2027-09-06 (allowing for 1-week buffer after PO)

I’ll draft a short risk register and attach the initial pricing file.

—Dylan

- 2027-08-15: Procurement issues PO / contract signed (Owner: Priya Patel / procurement@medlink.ai)

Attachments sent: MAP-medlink-v2.pdf, SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf. I also attached our initial pricing workbook (redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx) for internal reference.

Proposed kickoff: Jun 17, 10:00 AM PT — 30 minute technical sync (agenda: SE intro, security questionnaire walkthrough, timeline alignment). Erica — if that works, I’ll send the calendar invite with conferencing details.
